{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and number who converted
n_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
converted_count = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion fraction
conversion_fraction = converted_count / n_loyal

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number who converted: {converted_count}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")"}
